title: Glowing tulip
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='petal1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>

      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff4466'/>

    <linearGradient id='petal2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>

      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5577'/>

    <linearGradient id='stemGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#44dd66'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#22bb44'/>

  <path d='M50 22 Q40 32 38 48 Q44 52 48 46 Q48 34 50 30Z' fill='url(#petal1)'/>
  <path d='M50 22 Q60 32 62 48 Q56 52 52 46 Q52 34 50 30Z' fill='url(#petal1)'/>
  <path d='M50 28 Q44 40 42 52 Q48 56 50 50 Q52 56 58 52 Q56 40 50 28Z' fill='#ff99bb'/>
  <!-- Inner petals highlight -->
  <path d='M47 32 Q43 42 42 50 Q46 52 47 48 Q47 38 48 34Z' fill='#ffccdd'/>
  <path d='M53 32 Q57 42 58 50 Q54 52 53 48 Q53 38 52 34Z' fill='#ffccdd'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffddee'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffddee'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#ffddee'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='1' fill='#ffddee'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='57' r='1' fill='#ffddee'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='18' ry='3' fill='#ffdd55' opacity='0.35'/>
